# Harbour ferry (original)

Night harbour crossing for ui-kit. The picture — a double-ended ferry, lit skyline, and black water — is original art in `harbour.js`.

`ferry.html` plays it with the same local halftone player as the viaduct train: 192×108 square cells, 15fps, dots on black. `prefers-reduced-motion` holds one frame with the ferry centred.
